category.name: Web scraping and browser automation
category.description: Crawl, scrape and convert pages to Markdown/JSON, or drive a remote headless browser (clicks, forms, logins).

entries.name: Anchor Browser
entries.desc_en: Provision authenticated cloud browser sessions and turn any website into callable MCP tools for agents.
entries.notes: Authenticated (logged-in) browser sessions require a paid tier; free tier covers unauthenticated browsing only.

rate_limits.summary: Free plan: session creation capped at 5/min, up to 5 concurrent browsers

unit_price.summary: $0.01 per browser created + $0.05 per browser hour; Anchor proxy $8/GB

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Apify
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <token> for REST; browser-based OAuth2 or bearer token for hosted MCP
entries.free_tier: free plan: $5/mo platform usage credit, no card required
entries.desc_en: Run web scraping/automation 'Actors' from a marketplace of thousands, and manage datasets, via REST API or MCP server.
entries.notes: MCP search/docs tools work unauthenticated; running paid Actors consumes platform usage credit. Actor endpoints use /v2/actors/{actorId}/... (e.g. run-sync-get-dataset-items)

rate_limits.summary: 250,000 requests/min global per user; 60 req/s per resource by default (higher for some endpoints)

async_jobs.how: POST run returns run object; poll GET run or use webhooks; sync run endpoints wait up to 300 s

call.operation: run an Actor synchronously and get its dataset items
response_fields: [] (JSON array of dataset items; fields depend on the Actor)

unit_price.summary: Platform usage: $0.20 per compute unit (1 GB RAM for 1 hour) on Free and Starter plans; some Store Actors add their own per-result or per-event fees

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Bright Data
entries.free_tier: Free tier: 5,000 requests/month via the MCP server (renews on the 1st, no card required); other products pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Access Web Unlocker, SERP API, Scraping Browser, and structured datasets via REST API or MCP to pull web data at scale.
entries.notes: Large multi-product suite; pricing and free-tier limits vary significantly by product (Web Unlocker vs Scraping Browser vs Datasets).

call.operation: fetch a web page through Web Unlocker

unit_price.summary: Web Unlocker pay-as-you-go: $1.5 per 1,000 successful requests

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Browse AI API
entries.free_tier: free forever plan: 50 credits/mo, no card required
entries.desc_en: Trigger pre-built or custom 'robots' to extract and monitor web data via REST API, returning structured JSON.

async_jobs.how: robot tasks run asynchronously; get results via webhooks or by retrieving the task

call.async: poll GET https://api.browse.ai/v2/robots/{robotId}/tasks/{taskId} until status is successful or failed (or use a webhook)

unit_price.summary: 1 credit per 10 rows extracted or per screenshot; premium sites cost 2-10 credits minimum per task; extra credits about $0.013-$0.030 each depending on plan and billing period

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Browser Use Cloud API
entries.free_tier: $15 one-time signup credit for new accounts (Google/GitHub/Microsoft); paid usage afterward
entries.desc_en: Launch cloud browser sessions and run AI browser-automation agent tasks via REST API or Python/TypeScript SDK.
entries.notes: Pay-as-you-go: model cost + 20% and browsers at $0.02/hour, no per-run fees; no ongoing free tier beyond the signup credit.

rate_limits.summary: Per-project default max(25, 2x concurrency) req/s, capped at 100 RPS; edge WAF 1000 RPS per IP

async_jobs.how: tasks run asynchronously; poll the run/session status until complete

call.example: curl -X POST https://api.browser-use.com/api/v4/runs -H "X-Browser-Use-API-Key: $BROWSER_USE_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"task": "Find the current Bitcoin price"}'
call.async: poll GET https://api.browser-use.com/api/v4/runs/{run_id} until status is completed/failed/cancelled; output in result

unit_price.summary: Agent run: model token cost + 20% service fee (e.g. Claude Sonnet 5 $2.40 in / $12.00 out per 1M tokens); cloud browser $0.02/hour

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Browserbase (+ Stagehand)
entries.free_tier: Free tier: 1 browser hour/month, 3 concurrent browsers, 15 min/session, no card required
entries.desc_en: Run and control cloud headless browsers programmatically, with Stagehand adding natural-language page actions.
entries.notes: Billed by browser-hours; Stagehand SDK is open source but needs a browser backend such as Browserbase. Hosted MCP takes the key as ?browserbaseApiKey=; the mcp-server-browserbase repo is archived since 2026-07-20.

rate_limits.summary: Free plan: 3 concurrent browsers, 15 minutes per session

data_policy.summary: Free plan data retention limited to 7 days

unit_price.summary: Browser time beyond plan: $0.12 per browser hour (Developer, $20/mo incl. 100 h) or $0.10 (Startup, $99/mo incl. 500 h); proxies $12 or $10 per GB

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Diffbot
entries.free_tier: free plan: 10,000 credits/mo, no card required (5 req/min limit)
entries.desc_en: Automatically extract structured data (articles, products, people) from any URL via REST API, no custom parsing rules needed.
entries.notes: Also offers Knowledge Graph and Crawl products with separate pricing; official client library docs listed as 'coming soon'.

call.operation: extract an article from a URL

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Firecrawl
entries.free_tier: free tier: 1,000 credits/mo, no card required
entries.desc_en: Scrape, crawl, and extract structured data from any website via a single REST API call.
entries.notes: Also offers OAuth-based remote MCP endpoint (mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp-oauth) and a keyless trial with daily limits.

rate_limits.summary: Free: 2 concurrent requests; scrape/map/search 10/min; crawl and agent 2/min

async_jobs.how: crawl returns a job id; poll GET /v2/crawl/{id} or use webhooks (crawl.page, crawl.completed)

unit_price.summary: Scrape: 1 credit per page; Hobby plan 5,000 credits/month for $16/mo billed yearly ($19 monthly); free plan 1,000 credits

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Hyperbrowser
entries.free_tier: Free: Free plan with 5,000 credits (1 credit = $0.001), 1 concurrent browser, 7-day data retention; no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Spin up cloud browsers and call scrape, crawl, and structured-extract endpoints via REST API or MCP server.
entries.notes: SDKs are compatible with Playwright, Puppeteer, and Selenium.

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Oxylabs
entries.auth_hint: HTTP Basic Auth with API-user credentials (--user USERNAME:PASSWORD)
entries.free_tier: Trial: Web Scraper API free trial with up to 2,000 results one-time, no card required
entries.desc_en: Fetch web pages, search-engine results, and e-commerce data at scale via REST API with built-in proxy/unblocking infrastructure.
entries.notes: Enterprise-oriented pricing overall, but self-serve API-user creation and free trial are available via the dashboard. Official MCP is hosted at mcp.oxylabs.io; its GitHub repo was archived on 2026-09-16.

unit_price.summary: Web Scraper API (Free Trial/Micro): $1.15 per 1,000 results for other sites without JS ($1.00 Google, $0.50 Amazon), $1.35 per 1,000 with JS rendering; failed requests not charged

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Playwright MCP (Microsoft)
entries.auth_hint: no auth; runs as a local process via npx
entries.desc_en: Official Microsoft MCP server giving agents structured browser control (click, type, navigate) via Playwright's accessibility tree.
entries.notes: Runs locally/self-hosted via `npx @playwright/mcp`; no cloud hosting, account, or API key required, but needs a local or self-managed browser runtime. Apache-2.0 licensed.

entries.name: ScrapeGraphAI API
entries.free_tier: Trial: 500 API credits one-time on the Free plan (10 requests/min), no card required
entries.desc_en: Use AI-driven prompts to scrape and extract structured data from webpages via REST API or Python/JS SDK.
entries.notes: Also offers the open-source scrapegraph-ai library with LangChain/LlamaIndex integrations.

rate_limits.summary: Free plan: 10 requests/min, 1 concurrent crawl, 1 monitor; status polling not counted

async_jobs.how: crawl is async: start returns an id, poll the crawl get-status endpoint

call.operation: extract structured data from a web page with a prompt
call.example: curl -X POST https://v2-api.scrapegraphai.com/api/extract -H "SGAI-APIKEY: $SGAI_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"url":"https://example.com","prompt":"What is the title of this page?"}'

unit_price.summary: Extract: 5 credits per call (+5 with stealth); scrape to markdown 1 credit. Starter $20/mo for 10,000 credits (about $0.01 per extract); credit packs from $5 per 1,000 credits

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: ScraperAPI
entries.free_tier: Free: free plan with 1,000 API credits per month (max 5 concurrent connections); new accounts start with a 7-day trial of 5,000 one-time credits, no card required
entries.desc_en: Scrape any webpage with automatic proxy rotation, CAPTCHA handling, and JS rendering via a single REST API call.
entries.notes: Widely used alternative to ScrapingBee/Zyte; official hosted MCP server at mcp.scraperapi.com/mcp.

free_plan.quota: 1,000 API credits (after a 7-day 5,000-credit trial), max 5 concurrent connections

async_jobs.how: optional async endpoint https://async.scraperapi.com returns a job to fetch later

response_fields: response body: raw HTML of the target page

unit_price.summary: 1 API credit per normal request; render=true or premium=true 10 credits; Google/Bing SERP 25 credits; only successful (200/404) requests are charged

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Scrapfly
entries.auth_hint: key= query param for REST API; API key or OAuth2 for MCP server
entries.free_tier: 1,000 free credits/mo, no card required, no time limit
entries.desc_en: Scrape webpages, run cloud browsers, and capture screenshots via REST API or hosted MCP server with anti-bot bypass.
entries.notes: MCP usage draws from the same credit balance as direct API calls.

rate_limits.summary: Free plan: 5 concurrent requests; concurrency defined by subscription

async_jobs.how: optional: pass webhook_name to queue the request and receive the result on a webhook

unit_price.summary: Basic scrape (datacenter proxy, no JS) = 1 credit; with JS rendering = 6 credits; residential proxy = 25 credits. Extra credits $5.00 per 10k on Discovery ($30/mo, 200k credits)

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: ScrapingBee
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <key> (legacy: api_key query param, deprecated)
entries.free_tier: Trial: 1,000 free API credits one-time on signup, no card required; then Hobby plan $19/mo for 75,000 credits
entries.desc_en: Scrape any webpage with JS rendering, proxy rotation, and screenshot capture via a single REST API call.
entries.notes: Postman collection provided in place of a published OpenAPI spec. Hosted MCP takes the API key as an api_key query parameter on the server URL.

unit_price.summary: 1 credit per request without JS rendering, 5 credits with JS rendering (default), 10/25 with premium proxy; Hobby plan $19/mo for 75,000 credits

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Spider.cloud
entries.free_tier: Free: keyless /scrape endpoint, rate-limited (quota not published); other endpoints return 402 without a key
entries.desc_en: Crawl and scrape websites at scale, returning JSON/XML/CSV, via REST API, CLI, or MCP server.

unit_price.summary: Pay-as-you-go per request: $1 per GB of fetched content plus $0.0001 per CPU-minute; failed requests free (10,000 credits = $1)

entries.name: Steel
entries.free_tier: Trial: Launch plan is $0 + usage with $30 one-time usage credits valid 90 days (10 concurrent sessions, 60 requests/min); no Hobby plan
entries.desc_en: Create managed cloud browser sessions with stealth proxies and CAPTCHA solving, controllable via REST API or Playwright/Puppeteer.
entries.notes: Open-source self-hostable browser engine (steel-browser) also available; official MCP server at steel-dev/steel-mcp-server.

rate_limits.summary: Launch plan: 60 requests/min, 10 concurrent sessions, 15 min max session

unit_price.summary: Browser hours: $0.10/hour on Launch plan (CAPTCHA solves $3 per 1,000, proxy $10/GB)

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Zyte API
entries.auth_hint: HTTP Basic Auth: API key as username, blank password
entries.free_tier: Trial: $5 free credit one-time on signup, valid 30 days, no subscription needed; then pay-as-you-go or a monthly commitment
entries.desc_en: Fetch and auto-extract web pages (HTML, browser rendering, product/article data) via one HTTP API with ban avoidance.
entries.notes: Part of Zyte's broader suite (Scrapy Cloud, Zyte IDE).

rate_limits.summary: Per-API-key rate limit (429 /limits/over-user-limit); retry with exponential backoff

call.operation: fetch a web page (raw HTTP response body)

unit_price.summary: Pay-as-you-go: HTTP requests $0.13-$1.27 per 1,000 and browser-rendered requests $1.01-$16.08 per 1,000, depending on the site's difficulty tier; lower with monthly commitments

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint
